series.title: Germany BESS market in strong position but policy questions on grid fees, connections and FCAs cloud certainty
series.summary: The grid-scale energy storage market in Germany is in a strong position but key questions around grid fees, grid connections, FCAs and the upcoming capacity market remain, speakers at the upcoming Energy Storage Summit Germany 2026 said.
